 News Over two lakh JEE Main 2027 applicants yet to complete fee payment before November 22 deadline 
 While 9.05 lakh candidates have registered for Session-1, the National Testing Agency urges remaining applicants to finish fee submission and download confirmation pages within seven days JEE (Main) 2027: NTA receives 7.04 lakh forms with fees with Nov 22 as deadline IANS Updated on :  16 Nov 2026, 1:50 pm 
 Copied 
 New Delhi, Nov 16 (IANS): The National Testing Agency (NTA) said on Monday that as many as 7.04 lakh Join Entrance Examination (JEE) (Main) 2027 applicants have completed the form and deposited fees for Session-1, advising others to complete the formalities before the November 22 deadline. 
 With seven days to go for the form submission window to close, the NTA added that 7,04,316 candidates have successfully completed fee payment so far.
 In a post on social media platform X, the NTA said as many as 9,05,144 candidates have registered on the website but only 7,04,316 have completed the fee submission process.
 The NTA on X added, "Hey future engineers! Are you excited for your JEE (Main) 2027 Session-1 journey? Let's complete your registration one simple step at a time: 1. Upload your documents 2.Fill in your details 3.Complete the fee payment 4.Download your confirmation page You're in great company! Over 7,04,316 friends have already finished their process. Complete yours by November 22."
 Earlier this week, for JEE (Main) 2027, the NTA reminded applicants not to leave their online application halfway.
 The NTA said, "Candidates are advised to log in using their own DigiLocker/JanParichay/e-Pramaan (MeriPehchaan) credentials to avoid discrepancies in identity verification and biometric data at subsequent stages of the application process."
 It added that candidates are advised to do Re-KYC through DigiLocker before filling out the JEE (Main) 2027 online application form to ensure that their latest details are fetched. Candidates can click here for the process.
 For aspirants abroad in mind, the NTA issued an advisory to simplify the process of Aadhaar status and nationality-related category selection by JEE (Main) 2027 applicants in the country and abroad.
 In a message on X, the NTA said, "Let's simplify which category to select for JEE (Main) 2027 registration. Make sure your application reflects the exact match for your citizenship and Aadhaar status: Indian Nationals: Indian citizens, including NRIs with an Aadhaar card; Foreign Nationals: Foreign citizens and OCI cardholders; NRIs Having No Aadhaar: NRIs holding an Indian passport without Aadhaar."
 — 
 This report was published from a syndicated wire feed. Apart from the headline, the EdexLive Desk has not edited the copy.
